required_work: Close P2's selected-profile external-surface obligation in a P2-scoped record instead of the stage aggregate that closes P1, P2, and P3 together.
objective: Close the external-surface obligation of the P2 claim-ladder rung, and only that rung. This record joins the three P2 surface records — p2-external-surface-integrity-gate and its two subordinate checks — over one content-bound P2-reachable surface closure carrying one recorded disposition per surface, and refuses when any child is open, when a child was evaluated against a different closure revision, or when a surface disposition changed without its recorded conditions being met. P2_SELECTED_PROFILE_EXTERNAL_SURFACE_CLOSURE_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: P2's external-surface obligation is reported closed while a child is open, while a child closed against a different closure revision, or while a surface — the application launcher in particular — left the closure without its recorded removal conditions being satisfied.
selected_profile: The selected external design-partner profile (P2 only): the P2-reachable surface closure an independent user traverses on their own data. The application launcher is IN this profile with disposition `included`, owned by p2-external-surface-integrity-gate's launcher_disposition; it is globally reachable and a first-class Hypervisor surface, and its P2 bar is a canonical IOI catalog, IOI-owned taxonomy, and honest availability — not a complete application estate.

aggregate_verification_binding.binding_derivation: record_sha256 is the sha256 of each child record's exact file bytes and is re-derivable from this checkout. evidence_bundle_sha256 and binding_payload_sha256 are deliberately absent: no child has produced an evidence bundle yet, and this record does not carry a digest whose derivation it cannot state.
aggregate_verification_binding.nonclaim: This exact-digest binding is a private closure precondition. It does not promote a child, dependency, proof gate, aggregate, work item, stage, or claim-ladder rung, and it cannot substitute for literal-valid retained evidence.

in_scope: Own P2's selected-profile external-surface obligation as a distinct closure. M9's aggregate exit closes P1, P2, and P3 together; that conflation is why P2's surface obligation could neither be closed nor refused on its own terms, and this record exists to separate it. Nothing in this record is added to m9-selected-profile-aggregate-exit-and-claim-publication, and this record closes no stage.

Join exactly three children over one closure revision: p2-external-surface-integrity-gate (the joining gate that enumerates and content-binds the P2-reachable closure), p2-surface-provenance-integrity-check, and p2-launcher-catalog-availability-check. The join is a conjunction: all three retained literals must be present, literal-valid, and bound to the same closure enumeration.

Carry the closure's surface dispositions as closure material. Each surface in the P2-reachable closure has exactly one recorded disposition of `included` or `excluded`, owned by p2-external-surface-integrity-gate. The application launcher's disposition is `included` by default and by current owner ruling. This record refuses when a disposition changed between a child's evaluation and this closure, and when an `excluded` disposition is presented without every recorded removal condition satisfied.

Refuse a pass obtained by narrowing. A child that passed because a surface left the closure closes nothing here unless that surface's disposition records the change and the removal conditions for it were met; a failing check and inconvenient remediation are never among those conditions.
out_of_scope: P1 and P3. The internal product proof and the production-integrated profile close in their own records; this record carries neither, and adding a P1 or P3 obligation to it would recreate the conflation it exists to remove.

Stage closure. M9's stage exit is owned by m9-selected-profile-aggregate-exit-and-claim-publication and its M9_EXIT=0 literal. This record closes a claim-ladder rung's surface obligation, not a stage, and never promotes one.
Detection of any kind. This record performs no scan, no enumeration, and no surface reading of its own; every finding belongs to a child, and every repair belongs to the surface's own owner record.

The operational depth of the application estate. Whether an application is implemented is out of scope at every level of this closure; the bar is provenance, taxonomy ownership, and honest availability.
positive_proof: All three child literals are retained, literal-valid, and bound to one identical P2-reachable closure enumeration; every surface in that enumeration carries exactly one recorded disposition; the launcher's disposition is the one this closure was enumerated under; and the retained literal P2_SELECTED_PROFILE_EXTERNAL_SURFACE_CLOSURE_EXIT=0 appears exactly once.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Predeclared branches, each of which must refuse by name: a child literal absent, malformed, or duplicated; two children bound to different closure revisions; a child reporting pass while the joining gate is open; a surface present in one child's subject and absent from another's; the launcher's disposition recorded as `excluded` with a sidebar, modal, Home, alias, redirect, or deep-link path still resolving to it; an `excluded` disposition whose stated basis is a failed check or the cost of remediation; an `excluded` disposition with no updated closure digest or no passing negative-reachability verifier; a disposition changed after a child was evaluated but before this closure was computed; this record's children or literals folded into the M9 aggregate, or an M9/P1 obligation folded into this record.

The live defect this closure exists over is retained as its baseline: the reachable P2 surfaces currently carry externally derived product identity, taxonomy, sample data, branding, and links, inventoried at internal-docs/prompts/architecture-relative-comparison/runs/2026-07-28-leg0-v2-external-reference-residue-census.md. This record closes nothing until its children close against that baseline.
remaining_nonclaims: This record closes one claim-ladder rung's external-surface obligation. It closes no stage, promotes no stage state, and makes no statement about P1 or P3.
A close evidences that three children closed against one content-bound closure at one revision. It does not survive a change to the closure, and it is not a licensing, trademark, or legal clearance.

A recorded surface disposition is a profile fact, never a verdict. `included` claims only membership in the closure; `excluded` would claim only that no reachable path survives, never that the surface's obligations were discharged.
This record joins and refuses; it detects nothing and repairs nothing.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if the three children cannot be bound to one identical closure enumeration, or if any surface in that enumeration carries no recorded disposition or more than one, because a closure whose subject is ambiguous cannot be closed or refused. Never obtain a close by narrowing: a surface leaves the closure only when its recorded disposition says so and the removal conditions recorded for it were met. For the application launcher specifically, the only path from `included` to `excluded` is a genuine pre-cohort profile decision that removes every sidebar, modal, Home, alias, redirect, and deep-link path, updates the closure digest, and passes a negative-reachability verifier; a failing check or inconvenient remediation is never grounds. If this record cannot close, it refuses — it never escalates its obligation into the M9 aggregate.
exit_criteria: All three child literals are retained, literal-valid, bound to one identical closure enumeration, and every predeclared adversarial branch refuses by name.

Every surface in the bound closure carries exactly one recorded disposition, and any `excluded` disposition satisfies every recorded removal condition including the updated closure digest and a passing negative-reachability verifier.

The retained literal P2_SELECTED_PROFILE_EXTERNAL_SURFACE_CLOSURE_EXIT=0 appears exactly once, and no child, literal, or obligation of this record appears in m9-selected-profile-aggregate-exit-and-claim-publication.
source_provenance: Authored 2026-07-29 under the owner ruling that keeps the application launcher in the selected P2 profile and requires P2's selected-profile obligation to close in a P2-specific record rather than in the M9 aggregate, whose M9_EXIT=0 closes P1, P2, and P3 together. The three P2 surface records were rewired onto this record in the same amendment; nothing was added to the P1/M9 aggregate. Sub-aggregate precedent inside a stage is m1-5-protected-transitions.
